page.layout: One printed page of running text with a diagram of proportions in the middle; a narrow strip of the facing page visible at the right edge, partly cut off, with fragments of text in the right margin. Running head at top; page number at top left.

main_text.p: tecedentium rationum continuè minimis, postre- mus, alter uerò tertiæ rationis antecedens est, in- uersè ponantur, tumq; priore inuenti omnes, po- steriore sequentes multiplicentur: facti erunt da- tarum rationum cõtinuè minimi, atq; ita deinceps datis pluribus.

Exempli gratia, dentur tres rationes, 4 ad 3, 2 ad 1, 5 ad 6, minimis seu contra se primis proportionalibus terminis continuandæ: primùm igitur antecedentes duas rationes expedio, atq; ita 8.6.3 .inuenio. Et quoniam 3 postremus ex inuentis, primus est ad 5 reliquæ ratio- nis antecedentem: idcò transpositis ipsis, 5 multiplicet 8 & 6, fiunt 40, 30: tria uerò multiplicent sequentes 5 & 6, fiunt 15, 30, quatuor terminii datas tres rationes in minimis proportionaliter continuantes. Exemplum sic est:
